protocol.type: walk-forward feature ablation and cross-game rule transfer, WFL Classico adapted

gameRules.main: 10 distinct numbers from 1..20; score exact intersection size, expectation 5
gameRules.numerone: separate 1..20 draw; not blended with main hits
gameRules.time: calendar keys use recorded draw timestamp; all predictions use history strictly before target

protocol.promotionPolicy: Rank by raw holdout mean hits versus status quo; an observed positive difference is an exploratory challenger. Do not interpret a single holdout winner as statistically proven; confirm on next untouched rolling block before permanent promotion.
excludedRules: VinciCasa order-position transitions and P1-P5 rules do not apply because WFL numbers are an unordered set
SuperEnalotto six-of-90 combinatorics and 6/6,5/6,4/6 thresholds do not apply
